payload.note: Uniform one-site conditional-gap checkpoint: after translating each exact BT one-site fiber minimum to s=0, the product constraint u^2*v>=8^3 and two exact positive shifted polynomials prove s*F'(s)>=8*s^2 on both tails. The weighted Hardy-Muckenhoupt criterion gives B_+,B_-<=lambda^2/8, hence C_P,psi<=lambda^2/2 and, after psi=lambda*phi, the background-, volume-, site-, and coupling-uniform conditional bound Var(f|off-site)<=1/2 E[(partial_o f)^2|off-site]. This is the first nonconvex uniform local gap. Uniform inter-site influence, global Poincare/Witten coercivity, lowest-mode and interacting H^-1 bounds, continuum, Born, Krein, and Lorentzian gates remain open. The next gate is the exact conditional-mean response/influence Fourier symbol.
